Message: Property type must be one of 'Measure', 'Truth', 'Count', 'Vocab', 'Coverage'.
Message_nl: Eigenschap type moet een van 'Measure', 'Truth', 'Count', 'Vocab', 'Coverage' zijn.

Message: Property phenomenonTime/end is required when phenomenonTime/begin is present.
Message_nl: Eigenschap phenomenonTime/end is verplicht wanneer phenomenonTime/begin is opgenomen.

Message: Property validTime/end is required when validTime/begin is present.
Message_nl: Eigenschap validTime/end is verplicht wanneer validTime/begin is opgenomen.

Message: Property metadata/baseValue is required when metadata/baseUnit is present.
Message_nl: Eigenschap metadata/baseValue is verplicht wanneer metadata/baseUnit is opgenomen.

Message: Property metadata/baseValue is not allowed when type is not equal to 'Measure'.
Message_nl: Eigenschap metadata/baseValue is niet toegestaan wanneer type ongelijk is aan 'Measure'.

Message: Property metadata/baseUnit is not allowed when type is not equal to 'Measure'.
Message_nl: Eigenschap metadata/baseUnit is niet toegestaan wanneer type ongelijk is aan 'Measure'.

Message: Property parameter/quantity is required unless the result type is Vocab.
Message_nl: Eigenschap parameter/quantity is verplicht tenzij het resultaattype Vocab is.

Message: Property result/measure/uom is required when result type is Measure.
Message_nl: Eigenschap result/measure/uom is verplicht wanneer resultaattype Measure is.

Message: Property result/measure/value is required when result type is Measure.
Message_nl: Eigenschap result/measure/value is verplicht wanneer resultaattype Measure is.

Message: Property result/count is required when result type is Count.
Message_nl: Eigenschap result/count is verplicht wanneer resultaattype Count is.

Message: Property result/truth is required when result type is Truth.
Message_nl: Eigenschap result/truth is verplicht wanneer resultaattype Truth is.

Message: Property result/vocab/vocabulary is required when result type is Vocab.
Message_nl: Eigenschap result/vocab/vocabulary is verplicht wanneer resultaattype Vocab is.

Message: Property result/vocab/term is required when result type is Vocab.
Message_nl: Eigenschap result/vocab/term is verplicht wanneer resultaattype Vocab is.

Message: Property result/coverageJSON is required when result type is Coverage.
Message_nl: Eigenschap result/coverageJSON is verplicht wanneer resultaattype Coverage is.
